title: Irish Pasta Primavera
description: A colorful and flavorful vegetarian pasta dish inspired by Ireland, featuring sautéed herbs and spring vegetables.

ingredients.name: Fresh herbs (such as parsley, basil, and dill)

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions. Cook for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the baby carrots and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, until all the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the chopped fresh herbs.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the vegetables and herbs. If the pasta seems dry, add some of the reserved pasta water.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with additional chopped herbs if desired.
